tour.offer.title: Welcome to PowerVoice
tour.offer.body: Take a two-minute tour: choose your microphone, record a practice take, clean it up and export it.
tour.offer.hint: You can replay it any time from Help → Take the Tour.
tour.welcome.intro.title: Welcome to PowerVoice
tour.welcome.intro.body: PowerVoice edits one mono voice take at a time. Markers sit on the left, your take in the middle, the effects rack on the right, and meters and loudness along the bottom.
tour.welcome.devices.title: Choose your microphone
tour.welcome.devices.body: Open Audio Devices to pick your input (and its channel) and your output. Record stays unavailable until an input is chosen.
tour.welcome.record.title: Record a practice take
tour.welcome.record.body: Click Input to arm and check your level, then click Record — or press {shortcut} — and read a line. Takes are crash-safe while you record.
tour.welcome.record.wait: Click Record to continue, or choose Next to skip this step.
tour.welcome.time.title: Keep an eye on the time
tour.welcome.time.body: This is the playhead position. While you record, the take's time beside Record counts up in red. Press {shortcut} again to stop. You can loop a selection with the Loop button or {loop_shortcut} to refine a phrase.
tour.welcome.editor.title: Find your way around the take
tour.welcome.editor.body: Scroll with the mouse wheel, zoom with Ctrl + wheel or the {zoom_in} and {zoom_out} keys, and drag to select. {spectral} opens the spectral view, where hum, clicks and breaths stand out.
tour.welcome.markers.title: Mark the moments
tour.welcome.markers.body: Press {shortcut} to drop a marker at the playhead — a retake, a cough, a chapter. Click a marker in this list to jump to it.
tour.welcome.rack.title: Shape your voice
tour.welcome.rack.body: The rack runs effects live and changes nothing in the file until you export. Use Add module to insert a Parametric EQ, bypass a module to compare, or load a preset such as Podcast voice.
tour.welcome.noise.title: Remove background noise
tour.welcome.noise.body: Select half a second or more of room tone, choose Effects → Capture Noise Print ({shortcut}), then add Noise Reduction to the rack.
tour.welcome.dock.title: Check your levels
tour.welcome.dock.body: Meters and the analyzer show what you hear. On the Loudness tab, Analyze measures LUFS and true peak, and ACX Check tests Audible's rules. Normalize in the toolbar hits a target in one click.
tour.welcome.finish.title: Export, and find help
tour.welcome.finish.body: When it sounds right, choose File → Export… for WAV, FLAC or MP3 — exports render through the rack. Replay this tour from Help → Take the Tour, and use ? in a panel for a short tour of it.
tour.rack.panel.title: The effects rack
tour.rack.panel.body: Effects run top to bottom, live — during playback, monitoring and export. When the chain adds delay, the header shows how much.
tour.rack.add.title: Add a module
tour.rack.add.body: Add module lists the built-in effects — Noise Gate, Noise Reduction, Parametric EQ, Dynamics and True-Peak Limiter — plus the plugins you've installed.
tour.rack.slots.title: Work with modules
tour.rack.slots.body: Drag a module by its grip to reorder it. The power key bypasses it, and each module's menu holds its presets.
tour.rack.presets.title: Compare and reuse
tour.rack.presets.body: A/B switches between the processed and the original sound while you listen. Effects → Rack Presets loads a whole chain, such as Podcast voice or Audiobook (ACX).
tour.noise.select.title: Find some room tone
tour.noise.select.body: Drag across half a second to a minute of silence between phrases — room noise only, no voice.
tour.noise.capture.title: Capture a noise print
tour.noise.capture.body: Choose Capture Noise Print, or press {shortcut}. Noise Reduction learns that noise and removes it from the whole take.
tour.noise.reduce.title: Reduce, then listen
tour.noise.reduce.body: Add Noise Reduction to the rack if it isn't there yet, then adjust its amount. Compare with A/B — too much makes a voice sound watery.
tour.loudness.analyze.title: Measure loudness
tour.loudness.analyze.body: Analyze measures the whole file — as processed through the rack, or the source. Loudness is in LUFS, true peak in dBTP.
tour.loudness.readouts.title: Read the results
tour.loudness.readouts.body: I is integrated loudness, S-max and M-max the loudest short-term and momentary moments, LRA the loudness range, and TP the true peak.
tour.loudness.acx.title: ACX Check
tour.loudness.acx.body: Tests Audible's three rules — RMS −23 to −18 dB, peak at or below −3 dBFS, noise floor at or below −60 dB — and says how to fix a failure.
tour.loudness.normalize.title: Normalize in one click
tour.loudness.normalize.body: Normalize in the toolbar holds favourites for peak (dBFS) and loudness (LUFS) targets. Effects → Normalize… sets any other target.
tour.punch.select.title: Select what to redo
tour.punch.select.body: Drag across the part of the take you want to record again.
tour.punch.settings.title: Punch & pre-roll
tour.punch.settings.body: Set the pre-roll you hear before the selection (5 s by default), the post-roll after it, the crossfade, and Insert or Overwrite. Calibrate… lines up your interface's latency.
tour.punch.record.title: Punch in
tour.punch.record.body: With a selection, Record ({shortcut}) plays the pre-roll, records over exactly the selection, then plays the post-roll so you hear the join.
tour.plugins.tabs.title: Your plugins
tour.plugins.tabs.body: Plugins lists every effect PowerVoice found; Folders lists where it looks, including folders you add.
tour.plugins.toolbar.title: Search and rescan
tour.plugins.toolbar.body: Search by name, vendor or path. Rescan picks up new and changed files — or everything.
tour.plugins.list.title: Status at a glance
tour.plugins.list.body: Each plugin shows its format, channels and status: OK, Disabled, Blocklisted, or Flagged after crashes. Its switch shows or hides it in Add module.
tour.plugins.install.title: Install a module
tour.plugins.install.body: Install module… copies a CLAP plugin into your plugin folder, checks it in a sandbox, and adds its effects to Add module.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.not_remappable: Shortcuts aren't remappable in this version.
